title: Live: Fresh protests hit France amid heightened security
summary: Police and elite security forces are out in force in French cities as thousands participate in a new round of protests. The protest location was changed last minute in Paris. Follow DW.

image.caption: Police were out in full force on Saturday morningImage: Pedro Nunes/REUTERS

blocks.text: French police arrest 135 and seize weapons
France's Interior Minister, Laurent Nunez said that police had arrested 135 people and seized a variety of weapons as they deployed for nationwide demonstrations.
Nunez said police have been given orders to prevent renewed street violence.
He said weapons confiscated included metal balls, lead pellets, fireworks, slingshots, steel balls, improvised weapons, a katana and airsoft weapons.
He went on to say that, so far, "there has been no major incident."
Earlier this morning, Nunez posted on social media that he had visited personnel belonging to the Paris intervention unit who make up some of the contingent mobilized in Paris.
"Our forces are mobilized, our setup is in place. We are ready," Nunez said.
